SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m,
       count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids,
       sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
       min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n999,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n900,
       sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ntest,
       count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
       min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT count(*) AS dup_groups, sum(c) AS rows_in_dups FROM (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)

WITH m AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS mo, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
         sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_mismatch
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) AS mo, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.mo, m.gross, m.net, r.rpt_net, m.net - r.rpt_net AS gap, m.date_mismatch FROM m JOIN r USING (mo) ORDER BY 1
